xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited (formerly known as Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Private Limited) (the "Parent Company"), its subsidiaries (the Company and its subsidiaries together referred to as the "Group") and its joint ventures are engaged in developing renewable power projects and in generation and sale of green power. The status of the Parent Company has changed from private limited to public limited. Pursuant to the provisions of Section 18 of the Companies Act, 2013, read with Rule 33 of the Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014, as amended from time to time, and vide Shareholders’ approval dated 9th July, 2025, the name of the Parent Company has changed from 'Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Private Limited' to 'Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited' with effect from 7th August, 2025, on which date the Registrar of Companies, Mumbai gave its approval for the said conversion. The equity shares of the Parent Company were listed on National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) and BSE Limited (BSE) on 2nd March, 2026. The above unaudited consolidated financial results which are published in accordance with the Regulation 33 and 52(4) read with Regulation 63 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended (“Listing Regulations”), for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 3rd November, 2026. The above unaudited consolidated financial results have been subject to “Limited Review” by the statutory auditors of the Parent Company and they have expressed an unmodified conclusion on the unaudited consolidated financial results. The unaudited consolidated financial results of the Group and its joint ventures are in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in the Indian Accounting Standards ("Ind AS 34") “Interim Financial Reporting” as prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013. Disclosures in compliance with 52 (4) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 for the quarter and six months ended 30th September, 2026 are attached as Annexure I. The segment reporting of the Group and its joint ventures has been prepared in accordance with Ind AS 108 on "Operating Segments" as attached in Annexure II. The Managing Director of the Group and its joint ventures has been identified as Chief Operating Decision Maker (CODM) who allocates the resources based on analysis of various performance indicators of the Group and its joint ventures. The Company has completed its Initial Public Offer (IPO) on 02nd March, 2026. The details of utilisation of IPO proceeds from fresh issue of Rs. 11,492.46 million (net of issue expenses of Rs. 537.32 million) are as follows:

The Company raised net proceeds of INR 11,492.46 million from the fresh issue. It earmarked INR 11,226.74 million for prepayment of outstanding borrowings and INR 265.72 million for general corporate purposes. By 31 March 2026 it had utilised INR 5,236.74 million, and it utilised the balance of INR 6,255.72 million in the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The proceeds were fully utilised as at 30 September 2026, in line with the objects of the issue.

The IPO proceeds towards issue expenses in respect of fresh issue aggregating to Rs. 51.5 million are currently unutilised and parked in an escrow account.
During the six months ended 30th September, 2026, the Parent Company has prepaid its 11.50% p.a Listed, Rated, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures and 11.50% p.a Unlisted, Rated, Redeemable, Non-Convertible Debentures having aggregate principal amounting to Rs. 5,990 million on 02nd April, 2026 out of its IPO proceeds from fresh issue of equity shares. The original repayment of these debentures was due on 08th June, 2027.
Pursuant to the share purchase agreement dated 06th May, 2025 with Apple India Private Limited, the Parent Company has diluted 49% of its total investments in Clean Max Taurus Private Limited. During the six months period ended 30th September, 2026, the said transaction was completed on 14th May, 2026.

The Board of Directors of the Parent Company, at its meeting held on 31st July, 2026, approved the scheme of amalgamation of four wholly owned subsidiaries Clean Max Aditya Power Private Limited, Clean Max IPP 1 Private Limited, CMES Power 1 Private Limited and CMES Infinity Private Limited (“Amalgamating Companies”) with the Parent Company. The application has been filed on 17th October, 2026 and is subject to approval from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai and other regulatory authorities. The amalgamation is aimed at improving operational and management efficiencies and streamlining business operations across the group and it will be accounted as per Appendix C of Ind AS 103. This will not have any impact on the unaudited consolidated financial results.

During the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, the Parent Company issued additional senior, secured, rated, listed, redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures ("NCDs") (Green Debt Securities), on a private placement basis to certain identified investors, aggregating to Rs. 25,000 million(excluding premium of Rs. 15.77 million), in one or more tranches/series, vide Debenture Trustee Agreement dated 23rd September, 2026. The proceeds from the proposed issue of NCDs are intended to be utilized as per the terms agreed in the debenture trust deed which includes capital expenditure for projects and repayment/prepayment of long-term borrowings, general corporate purposes, etc. The details of utilisation of debenture proceeds from issue are as follow:
The Company raised INR 25,000.00 million through the issue of debentures. Of this, it had utilised INR 16,922.52 million towards the objects of the issue up to 30 September 2026, leaving INR 8,077.48 million unutilised as at that date.
As at 30 September 2026, out of the total unutilized proceeds, Rs. 7,169.20 million had been invested in debt mutual funds, being a permitted mode of investment under the terms of the Debenture Trust Deed, while the remaining Rs. 908.28 million was held in the escrow account.

During the quarter ended 30th September 2026, the Company amended and restated the Debenture Trust Deed dated 18 August 2026 in relation to the Rs.4,000 million NCDs, pursuant to which the status of the debentures was changed from unsecured to secured. The corresponding charge has been filed with the Registrar of Companies and was registered on 19th October 2026. Accordingly, the asset cover has been computed after considering the security package envisaged under the amended deed, including a subservient charge over the Company's cash flows and receivables, an exclusive charge over partnership interests in specified LLPs, pledge of shares of identified project companies, deposits maintained in designated accounts in relation to the debentures, and specified assets of a subsidiary.

Figures for audited consolidated financial information for the six months ended 30th September, 2025 have been approved by the Parent Company's Board of Directors in their meeting held on 19th November, 2025. Statutory Auditors have expressed unmodified opinion on the said financial information via their report dated 19th November, 2025.
Figures for unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter ended 30th September, 2025 have been approved by the Parent Company's Board of Directors in their meeting held on 03rd November, 2026.
The above unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of the Group and its joint ventures are available on the Parent Company's website (www.cleanmax.com) and that of NSE (www.nseindia.com) and BSE (www.bseindia.com).
Financial Results of Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited (Formerly known as Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Private Limited):

For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the Company reported total income (revenue from operations and other income) of INR 13,805.63 million, against INR 22,972.75 million in the preceding quarter and INR 15,485.57 million in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Profit before tax for the quarter was INR 2,104.62 million and profit after tax was INR 1,563.36 million. The corresponding figures were INR 4,682.17 million and INR 3,501.99 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, and INR 3,187.64 million and INR 2,390.32 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2025. For the six months ended 30 September 2026, total income was INR 36,778.38 million, profit before tax INR 6,786.79 million and profit after tax INR 5,065.35 million, against INR 27,382.12 million, INR 4,930.90 million and INR 3,725.77 million for the six months ended 30 September 2025. For the year ended 31 March 2026 (audited), the Company reported total income of INR 63,573.12 million, profit before tax of INR 10,390.65 million and profit after tax of INR 7,673.49 million. The figures for the quarters and six-month periods are unaudited.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnSegmentsExp:
a. Renewable Energy Power Sales is the segment that sells electricity to customers through long-term PPAs and EAPAs, with offerings including Onsite Solar, Offsite, STU-Connected, and CTU-Connected.
b. Renewable Energy Services Segment includes third party Engineering Procurement and Commissioning services and carbon services.
c. Unallocable Income and Expenses
i. Unallocable income includes cash flow hedges - ineffective portion of changes in fair value, profit on derecognition of ROU, Net foreign exchange gain, Interest income from amortisation of financial liability, gain on modification of borrowing terms, gain on change of ownership interest in subsidiary, gain on sale of property, plant and equipment (net) and gain on financial assets classified at fair value through profit and loss
ii. Unallocable expenses include gratuity expense, employee share based payment expenses, net foreign currency exchange loss, bad debts written off, expected credit loss allowance, MTM loss on forward contracts (net), non-operating sundry expense, loss on derecognition of ROU and loss on assets sold/written off.
d. Segment Assets and Segment Liabilities are as at 30th September, 2026, 30th June, 2026, 30th September, 2025 and 31st March, 2026. Unallocable assets and liabilities mainly include deferred tax assets and liabilities, income tax assets and liabilities, security deposit, cash and cash equivalents and statutory obligations.
